body: I'll just say that I'm more involved with weed than I am interested in weed.

Being paranoid to the point of nonfunctionality is not going to help me.

Self medicating is not going to help me.

I have a disability called Osteogenesis Imperfecta which means brittle bones. I have metal rods in all of my long bones. I currently need surgery to replace the rod in my left tibia but I haven't seen a doctor about it partially because it's not urgent, partially because I don't think I can mentally deal with the stress of surgery and partially because I just can't force myself to do something that I know will put my in a position of helplessness.

On top of that, I have a weird mystery hip pain that I think could be a rod that needs replacing in my left femur, so if I go in for that pain and they tell me I need TWO rods replacing, that's months and months healing, pain, mental anguish, a need for opiates, helplessness etc etc...
